quarterly_data.signal: In its IDWeek 2026 preview (more than 50 abstracts, 12 oral presentations) Pfizer states vaccine pipeline status: the EMA has started review of the Marketing Authorization Application for LB6V (PF-07307405), the 6-valent OspA-based Lyme disease vaccine candidate developed with Valneva (announced August 2026), whose Phase 3 VALOR results follow the March 2026 topline readout; and Phase 2 data for the 25-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine candidate (PF-07872412; 25vPnC) versus PREVNAR 20 in infants inform its ongoing pediatric Phase 3 program.
